items.k: Email your MP. Cite one file from this site. Demand a date.
Print one chapter. Hand it to a neighbour.
Sign one petition on the House e-petition portal. Track the response.
File one ATIP request. The form is free. The clock is the point.
Run for one local seat. School board. Council. Any seat.
Show this walkthrough to one person who disagrees with you.
Save the transcript. Save the sources. The record is the weapon.
